name: Bad Romance
source:
When the prison walls fall, so do the rules. Trapped with dangerously hot villains, our hero must seduce to survive – and embrace their most scandalous powers.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
監獄的牆一倒，規矩也一起倒下。我們的英雄和一群性感得危險的反派困在一起，必須靠色誘求生，還得擁抱自己最離經叛道的力量。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
